intro: A battered parchment map sets Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure in motion along Westfall's coast. The hunt begins with a search of the shoreline for the late captain's personal footlocker, then leads toward his hidden plunder across the region.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave. So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues.

First ye need to find me footlocker. It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of Westfall near the shipwreck. There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast. Find that anchor and you'll find me locker! Look in there for the next clue.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The footlocker slowly creaks open. Sand and water seem to be its only contents. But wait! A small crab scurries out with a clue to the treasure in his claws!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
